facsat2.title: Premature re-entry of the FACSAT-2 nanosatellite: orbital decay and attribution to the maximum of solar cycle 25

xraydoppler.title: First Detection of the Doppler Shift of X-ray Photons Due to a Telescope's Orbital Motion

cases.question: What is the NORAD catalogue ID of FACSAT-2?
On what date did FACSAT-2 re-enter the atmosphere?
How many days after deployment did FACSAT-2 re-enter?
What service life had been declared for the mission?
cases.gold_answer: at least five years (with an estimated orbital lifetime of fifteen)

cases.question: Which atmospheric density model did the authors use, and through which software package?
cases.gold_answer: NRLMSISE-00 (Picone et al. 2002) via the Python package pymsis 0.12.0

cases.question: What median effective ballistic coefficient did the authors infer?
How many TLE sets were used, over what date range, and at what median cadence?
cases.gold_answer: 3696 sets between 18 April 2023 and 27 October 2025, median cadence 6.2 h

cases.question: What form factor and mass was FACSAT-2?
How long did the satellite take to descend from 400 km to 300 km, compared with the final 180 km?
cases.gold_answer: 234 days for 400->300 km, but only 25 days for the remaining 180 km

cases.question: By what factor did the measured solar forcing shorten the orbital lifetime relative to the design-time forecast?
cases.gold_answer: a factor of about 1.52 (3.83 years forecast vs 2.53 years measured)

cases.question: What was the total contract cost of the FACSAT-2 mission in US dollars?
cases.why_absent: The paper discusses delta-v cost in m/s and mass cost, never a monetary figure.

cases.question: What downlink data rate in Mbps did the satellite's radio achieve?
cases.why_absent: 'Mbps' and 'downlink' appear nowhere in the paper.

cases.question: What altitude is the initial circular parking orbit around Earth?
What altitude is the final circular orbit around the Moon?
cases.gold_section: 2.3. Initial and final circular parking orbits

cases.question: What Earth-Moon orbital period does the model assume?
Which mathematical framework is used to embed the boundary conditions analytically?
cases.gold_section: 2.5. The overdetermined constraints technique based on TFC

cases.question: What dynamical model is the transfer formulated in?
What range of times of flight was investigated when studying how the initial inclination affects the final lunar inclination?
Which approximate approach do the authors compare their results against?
cases.gold_answer: a Patched-Conics approach combined with a Hohmann transfer

cases.question: What is the spacecraft's dry mass in kilograms?
cases.why_absent: The paper works in delta-v only; the string 'kg' does not appear anywhere.

cases.question: Which launch vehicle is assumed for the mission?
cases.why_absent: 'launch vehicle' appears nowhere; the study starts from a parking orbit.

cases.question: What effect did this paper detect for the first time?
cases.gold_answer: the redshifting and blueshifting of X-ray photons caused by an X-ray telescope's orbital motion around Earth

cases.question: Which instrument's observations were analysed?
What energy resolution R can current and planned calorimeter X-ray telescopes achieve?
How many XRISM observations were analysed, and of what kind of target?
cases.gold_answer: four observations of galactic centre molecular clouds with narrow Fe K-alpha lines

cases.question: What velocity difference was measured for G0.11-0.11 in observation 201052010?
At what confidence level was the redshift modulation detected?
What is the total budgeted cost of the XRISM mission?
cases.why_absent: The word 'cost' does not appear in the paper.

label_rule: gold_pages lists every page on which the answer is STATED, judged by whether a reader of that page alone could answer the question. Derived by searching the extracted text for the answer string and inspecting each hit's context; a page where the string appears in a reference list, figure caption or unrelated role is not gold. Labels were corrected once, uniformly across all 23 answerable cases, after an initial baseline run showed a 'miss' that was really an over-narrow label (rag-027: the 95% confidence level is stated on five pages, and the retriever returned two of them). See ADR-007.
